title: The UHD Universe
caption: A stargazer beneath the Milky Way at the Very Large Telescope, Paranal Observatory, Chile
celestial: Photograph taken at Paranal Observatory, Chile

recognition.text: ESO Picture of the Week (an editorial selection, not an audience score).

story: On the right of the frame, a stargazer points up at the arc of the Milky Way curving overhead at ESO's Paranal Observatory. Across the left are the telescopes of the Very Large Telescope (VLT), all four boxy Unit Telescopes plus three of the rounder Auxiliary Telescopes, of which there are four. The pointing figure is ESO Photo Ambassador Babak Tafreshi.

Tafreshi was one of four leading astrophotographers and videographers who travelled to Paranal in 2016 for ESO's UHD Expedition. Over a few weeks they gathered ultra high definition stills, fulldome timelapses, 360-degree panoramas and plenty of other views of their surroundings, all aimed at planetarium shows.

The results are used by the ESO Supernova Planetarium & Visitor Centre. ESO runs the centre jointly with the Heidelberg Institute for Theoretical Studies, in a building donated by the German foundation Klaus Tschira Stiftung.

understand.summary: This is a ground-based photograph from ESO's UHD Expedition, credited to ESO/B. Tafreshi. The source does not publish camera, exposure or colour-processing details.
understand.eye: A camera can gather light for longer than the eye, so the Milky Way may look brighter and more detailed here than to the stargazer pointing at it.
